observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoor stage with wooden floor, decorative backdrop featuring ethnic embroidery motifs and floral wreath, theatrical lighting.
observation.dancers: Large group of mixed adult dancers, approximately equal numbers of men and women.
observation.formation_and_space: Begins in straight horizontal lines along the back, shifts into circular group formations, partner pairs turning and moving across the stage space.
observation.posture: Upright torso, lifted chest, slight knee bend during steps, erect carriage.
observation.footwork: Lively stepping patterns including high kicks, small hops, rapid stamp steps, traveling sideways and forward on the beat; delicate footwork cannot be seen clearly due to distance.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held high overhead with wrists bent or extended outward, placed on hips, or extended to hold partners' hands; women hold white handkerchiefs in one hand.
observation.hips_and_torso: Generally held upright and steady with occasional rotation or bend during partner turns.
observation.partnering: Couples hold hands or embrace in circular patterns, executing coordinated turns and partner interactions.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent high leaps, rapid spinning turns, brief moments of kneeling on one knee.
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional stage folk attire: men in white shirts, dark vests, white trousers, and dark boots; women in white blouses, patterned skirts, embroidered vests, and small white headwear. Women hold small white handkerchiefs.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact individual foot articulation and subtle weight-shift details are obscured by distance and stage lighting.

signature_moments.what: Male dancers leaping high into the air with bent knees while swinging arms overhead.
Dancers forming concentric circles spinning rapidly while women's skirts flare out.
Dancers dropping simultaneously to one knee in a line across the stage.
